body.input: [T6c#3 wakeUp-repeat] Call the generate_image tool with prompt='wakeup-stress-test' and callbackMode='wakeUp'. Two valid outcomes: (a) DEFERRED - you get a taskId and no image yet → end with STEP_OK; OR (b) INLINE - a fast task returns the image immediately (an imageUrl field or a markdown image link) → end with WAKEUP_OK. Either is correct. Only end with FAILED: <reason> if you get neither a taskId nor an image. If you got a taskId (deferred), you will be revived when the image is ready - on revival confirm the image URL (http/https, as a field or markdown link) is present and end with WAKEUP_OK, or WAKEUP_FAILED: <reason> if no image URL appears.
